scientific_integrity: Sharp open-range stability coefficient and positive-cell theorem are cited established inputs. The new proof derives the singular critical limit; finite quadrature does not certify infinite convergence or independence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension d>=3 and unnormalized surface measure. D_d is a convergent oscillatory integral, not an elementary closed form; a critical-exponent inequality and d=2 statement are not claimed. Equivalence with unindexed literature remains possible.
title: A universal critical \(1/d\)-cusp in sharp spherical Fourier-extension stability
